Title: Patient registration and login
Description: As a patient, I want to register and log in so that I can securely access my healthcare dashboard.
Acceptance Criteria: Unique valid account; hashed password; invalid login error; protected routes

Title: Manage patient profile
Description: As a patient, I want to update my profile so that my information remains accurate.
Acceptance Criteria: Patient updates own profile; validation errors shown; ownership enforced

Title: Symptom guidance chatbot
Description: As a patient, I want to describe symptoms to a chatbot so that I can receive general guidance.
Acceptance Criteria: Supported symptom response; follow-up; emergency escalation; saved messages

Title: Common health questions
Description: As a patient, I want to ask health questions so that I can learn about common symptoms and prevention.
Acceptance Criteria: Supported topics answered; unknown fallback; no diagnosis or prescriptions

Title: Search doctor directory
Description: As a patient, I want to search doctors by specialization so that I can find a suitable doctor.
Acceptance Criteria: Search by name/specialty; future available slots shown

Title: Book appointment
Description: As a patient, I want to book an appointment so that I can schedule a consultation.
Acceptance Criteria: Future slot booked once; past/taken rejected; own cancel; released slot

Title: Review chatbot history
Description: As a patient, I want to view previous chatbot conversations so that I can refer to earlier guidance.
Acceptance Criteria: Patient-scoped chat history; message search; no cross-account access

Title: Track medical activity
Description: As a patient, I want appointment and medical history so that I can track my activities.
Acceptance Criteria: Own appointment statuses; private notes; accurate dashboard
